rule: ruling:sam-2026-10-07 claims 1, 5 and 7 (ruling-sam-2026-10-07-p1-001, -p1-008, -p1-013): the real service matches Design Release 2.1, the prototype wins by default, and a question is raised only when the default does not settle it; DR2.1's shared status line deliberately renders a 'Cancel amend' button that opens the cancel amendment modal on every page that includes it, and the hub's missing modal include is an inferred omission in one prototype page, not a design choice, so the default (the designed behaviour) settles it with no DR1 judgement or real constraint overriding it.
outcome: During an amendment the hub's status line shows 'Cancel amend', and it opens the same cancel-amendment confirmation the review page uses. DR2.1's shared status line designs the button to open the cancel amendment modal; the hub page's missing modal include is a prototype omission, not a design intent, and the ruling's prototype-wins default follows the designed behaviour.
